_doc: RANDOM EVENTS — ambient encounters that pay forward (DNA §4: the world remembering kindness is the single best trick in the game). v1: STRANDED — a driver beside a dead sedan on the frontage road; hook it, haul it to Longhorn Impound, get paid, and they owe you one. A favor covers the bail the next time you are busted. Read by systems/random_events.gd at boot.

drivers.name: DELIA
drivers.hail: Delia's cousin at the county covered your bail.

drivers.name: RAY
drivers.hail: Ray called in a favor at the impound. No bail.

drivers.name: MARISOL
drivers.hail: Marisol knows the desk sergeant. Bail's handled.

drivers.name: TINO
drivers.hail: Tino's uncle runs the tow lot. You walk.

drivers.name: COACH PRUITT
drivers.hail: Coach Pruitt made a call. Bail's covered. This is our year.

_tuning: first_delay under 30 s lands an event on top of the tutorial dispatch; intervals under a minute make the frontage road a taxi rank. pay 220 sits under a repo (250-450) because the favor is the real wage.
